headline: OnMobile Global partners with Savex Technologies to distribute ONMO+ smart consoles across India
hook: New pan-India distribution push for ONMO+
summary: OnMobile Global Limited has announced a partnership with Savex Technologies to expand the distribution of its ONMO+ smart console across the Indian market. The collaboration aims to leverage Savex's distribution network to reach a wider audience of consumers in the country. For Indian retail investors, this marks a strategic commercial effort by OnMobile to scale its product footprint domestically. The partnership's ultimate impact on the company's top line will depend on consumer adoption rates of the console.
whats_next: Quarterly financial results showing distribution revenue impact
why_it_matters: Wider domestic distribution could boost ONMO+ sales volumes.

headline: OnMobile partners with Savex Technologies for hardware distribution
hook: OnMobile expands gaming hardware retail footprint
summary: OnMobile Global has signed a distribution agreement with Savex Technologies to sell its ONMO+ Smart Console in India. The deal covers distribution through large format retail, regional retail, e-commerce, and quick-commerce channels on a stock-and-sale basis. This move shifts the product from a purely online model to an omnichannel retail strategy. The agreement was officially executed on October 28, 2026.
why_it_matters: Wider retail access could boost hardware sales and brand visibility.
winners_losers: OnMobile gains / Online-only competitors face pressure

headline: OnMobile Global submits investor presentation to the stock exchanges
hook: Routine investor update from OnMobile Global
summary: OnMobile Global Limited has officially filed its investor presentation with the stock exchanges. The company routinely releases such presentations to provide stakeholders with insights into its financial standing, operations, and strategic outlook. Indian retail investors tracking the company can review the presentation for updated management commentary and performance metrics. These filings are standard disclosures required for listed entities.
why_it_matters: New strategic updates available for OnMobile shareholders

headline: OnMobile Global publishes financial results for the second quarter of fiscal 2027
hook: Second quarter scorecard for OnMobile Global
summary: OnMobile Global Limited has submitted a press release to the stock exchanges detailing its financial performance for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company's disclosure covers the period ending September 2026. Exchange filings of this nature provide retail shareholders with updated revenue and profitability figures. Investors track these periodic updates to assess the company's ongoing operational performance.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings update for OnMobile shareholders.

headline: OnMobile Global board approves Q2 financial results
hook: September quarter numbers reviewed by OnMobile
summary: OnMobile Global Limited's board met on October 28, 2026, to approve the company's standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The meeting concluded with the submission of these results along with the auditor's limited review report, complying with Regulation 33 of the Listing Regulations. Retail investors tracking the telecom sector can review these financial statements to assess the company's quarterly performance.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for OnMobile shareholders

headline: OnMobile submits quarterly depository participant compliance certificate
hook: Routine regulatory filing by OnMobile Global
summary: OnMobile Global has submitted its compliance certificate under Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. The document covers the quarter ended September 30, 2026. It was received from the company's Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies Limited. This is a mandatory corporate governance filing for listed entities.
why_it_matters: Standard compliance filing with no impact on share price
